headings: RED ZARA TEMPTATION & SANDALWOOD EXTRAIT DE PARFUM

jsonld_raw.name: RED ZARA TEMPTATION & SANDALWOOD EXTRAIT DE PARFUM 50 ML (1.7 FL. OZ.)
jsonld_raw.description:
RED ZARA TEMPTATION & SANDALWOOD EXTRAIT DE PARFUM 50 ML (1.7 FL. OZ.). A highly concentrated extrait de parfum that reveals the creamiest and most sophisticated facet of the Red Zara Temptation accord. Lactonic sandalwood takes center stage in the composition, enhanced by white pepper and saffron. A powdery veil of violet and iris softens the heart, while ambergris and tonka create a deep, velvety amber base.

Woody Amber | Velvety, deep, and sophisticated
